diagram_candidates.source_claim: The PDE transports age along a(t)=a(0)+t with mortality survival; the mild solution separates individuals from the initial cohort (a≥t) and births entering at age zero (0≤a<t), then follows each characteristic to time t (lines 37–53).
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The two characteristic families meet at the renewal corner and the cases in the mild formula are naturally spatial; the preview contains the equations without a picture.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: Draw the (time, age) quadrant with characteristics of slope da/dt=1. Show an initial-cohort ray from (0,a0) reaching (t,a0+t), with survival S(a0,t), and a boundary-birth ray from (s,0) reaching (t,t−s), with survival S(0,t−s). Mark the renewal boundary B(s), the switch a=t, and distinguish inflow at a=0 from absorbing age infinity; do not imply a finite age cutoff.
diagram_candidates.limitation: Optional explanatory schematic; the mild formula already states both cases and the proof does not depend on a diagram.

diagram_candidates.source_claim: The all-at-once bidiagonal operator encodes u_i=Φ_i u_{i−1}+g_i; coarsening marks 0,m,2m,…,N as C-points and the remaining unknown indices as F-points, then permutes into F/C blocks (lines 31–35).
diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The F/C index partition and the distinction between practical coarse propagation and exact elimination are index-sensitive and are easier to check on a small labeled grid.
diagram_candidates.content_to_draw_or_check: For N=6,m=2, mark the initial value u0, C nodes 2,4,6, F nodes 1,3,5, arrows Φ_i from i−1 to i, and forcing g_i. Pair it with a block matrix layout after (v_F,v_C) permutation, labeling A_FF,A_FC,A_CF,A_CC. Distinguish the practical coarse map Ψ_j from the Schur-complement operator formed by eliminating F points; do not assert stability or convergence.
diagram_candidates.limitation: Optional index schematic; no missing logical step is indicated.
